Hi Aisha — thanks for the diagram and the clear asks. Happy to run the kickoff. I'm including Kimberly (networking lead for Private deployments) and Monica (implementation PM) so we can assign owners and map out milestones. Quick replies to your asks: 

- VPC peering & endpoints: supported. We typically do a cross-account VPC peering into a dedicated Private VPC per customer and create interface endpoints for the control plane. We will share a preflight checklist with exact route table changes and SG recommendations.
- IP ranges: prefer non-overlapping /16 or /20 depending on scale; we'll provide acceptable CIDR ranges and an overlap detection step.
- CMK support: Redwood Private supports customer-managed KMS for the data plane; we'll need a KMS key ARN and a minimal IAM role for decryption during setup.
- On-prem appliance: typical lead time is 4–6 weeks for appliance prep + 2–3 days for onsite install (if needed). We can offer a staging appliance for acceptance testing.

Attaching a short draft runbook (runbook-draft-20260803.md) with a proposed 8-week timeline and preflight checklist. Proposed kickoff windows (PDT):
- Tue Aug 4, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Aug 5, 14:00–15:00
